title: Your database deserves version control too
look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a messy console, a git-vs-memory split, a folder of .ddl files, dbd commands, a pull-request diff, and the dbd end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.name: Where it lives
scenes.desc: A messy console: the schema lives in scripts, sessions and memory.

scenes.name: Git vs memory
scenes.desc: Code is in git, reviewed, tested; the schema is scripts, a console and memory.

scenes.name: Tables as files
scenes.desc: A folder of .ddl files: every table is a file you can review.

scenes.name: The loop
scenes.desc: dbd init, inspect, apply: ordered, applied, migrated, documented.

scenes.name: The pull request
scenes.desc: AI-written SQL lands in a pull request diff, not in production.

scenes.name: dbd
scenes.desc: End card with the dbd mark: schema design that lives in your terminal.
